description: List the customer's OWN connected devices (Jetson, Snapdragon hosts, gateways) with live/offline status computed from each device's heartbeat (30s beat, 90s window). This is the workspace fleet connected via `edgegate-runner agent` — NOT the global AI Hub catalog (use edgegate_list_devices for that). If empty, the response includes copy-paste connect instructions for the customer.
name: edgegate_list_device_targets
